lines: {target}? Green stalks can hide quick trouble. I would keep blades sharp and tempers sheathed.
If anyone heads for Bamboo Jungle, tell them: Keep a path cut behind you. I will be at the grindstone.
Bamboo crowds the eye and the feet. I will remember that when I turn the grindstone.
Bamboo Jungle is no small story. A weapon is not a plan.
I will remember Bamboo Jungle as a green wall that rustles like whispers. I will keep the edge sharp and the blade sheathed.
